Torgga is one of the bandits raiding the Overgrown Ruins in Act One.

Involvement

Act One

Torgga is in the Refectory inspecting the library for loot together with  Cefrey,  Barton, and  Haseid, while  Mari patrols the antechamber and  Andorn guards the Chapel Entrance. Barton and the others are instantly hostile to the party.
